assertion.zh: 在稳态自由流条件下,向 3 辆 HV 车队中插入一辆 AV(构成 HV-AV-HV)会使车队最小碰撞时间下降至少 20%。
assertion.en: Under steady free-flow conditions, inserting a single AV into a 3-vehicle HV platoon (forming HV-AV-HV) lowers the platoon minimum time-to-collision by at least 20% relative to a homogeneous all-HV platoon.

prediction.zh: 在固定随机种子 20260909 的确定性仿真中,HV-AV-HV 车队的最小碰撞时间应比全 HV 车队低至少 20%。
prediction.en: In the deterministic simulation with fixed seed 20260909, the HV-AV-HV platoon minimum time-to-collision shall fall at least 20% below the all-HV baseline.

falsification.condition: If the HV-AV-HV platoon minimum time-to-collision is NOT higher than the all-HV baseline platoon minimum by at least 20% (i.e. (variant - baseline)/baseline < 0.20), the claim is falsified.
falsification.scope: Claim is scoped to steady free-flow; the stop-and-go boundary (see boundary-counterexample.json) is explicitly excluded and is expected to break it. Three vehicles on one lane under a declared periodic disturbance, with no stochasticity.

disclaimer: FIXTURE falsifiable claim. Numbers used for falsification are MOCK deterministic values in mock-experiment.json; this is not a real empirical finding.
metricNote: BOUND METRIC. The claim is bound to `min-ttc-seconds` because that is the quantity the study can measure and that can move. It is NOT bound to `ttcLt1_5_rate_pct`, the column this pack's own mock rows are written in, because under the study's model that band is not entered. That is a MEASUREMENT, not an argument: across disturbance amplitudes from 5 m/s to a near-total stop (24 m/s of a 25 m/s cruise) and across desired headways from 2.0 s down to 0.3 s, the measured rate is 0.00% in every case and the platoon minimum time-to-collision never falls below 2.08 s. A rate that does not move cannot adjudicate anything, so the run measures and REPORTS it without binding the claim to it.

commitment.note: DECLARED for this task: the same study, a claim that commits the other way. Synthetic fixture for the multi-task quality baseline.
